title: Give the ketone hydrogen
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Borohydride reduces a ketone to a secondary alcohol after workup. The former carbonyl carbon retains both carbon neighbors and gains a hydrogen.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of propanone under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Propanone is treated with NaBH₄, then water. Which major organic product forms after workup? Borohydride reduces a ketone to a secondary alcohol after workup. The former carbonyl carbon retains both carbon neighbors and gains a hydrogen.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
